first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so a guarded onboarding simplification test addresses the clearest coupled failure while avoiding immediate margin erosion from broad discounts. Verify memory_86 for the direct onboarding precedent and memory_73 because competitor pricing creates a consequential alternative whose acquisition and revenue lift may not be sustainable or qualified. Measure first meaningful action, qualified pipeline or revenue, retention, and segment effects before scaling.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segmented onboarding simplification experiment focused on restoring completion and activation. The verified precedent showed completion +13%, time-to-value improving by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, making this the strongest sustainable-revenue response to both current declines. Do not use broad promotional pricing: although it drove qualified revenue +18%, 30-day retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Track completion, first meaningful action, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention by segment before rollout.
